subject: E-Commerce
title: Autonomous Delivery Vans
description: A micro-lesson that makes Autonomous Delivery Vans usable.

hook.text: Nuro's driverless delivery vans carry groceries on real roads. No driver, no wages, running 24 hours a day.

buildup.text: Autonomous vans are smaller than regular cars and carry only cargo. No passengers means different safety parameters.

discovery.text: Walmart partnered with Gatik for autonomous delivery trucks that shuttle goods between warehouses and stores.

twist.text: Self-driving delivery faces the same regulatory maze as self-driving cars. Each city and state has different rules.

climax.text: Autonomous vans could cut last-mile costs by 80%. The technology works; regulation and public trust lag behind.

punchline.text: No driver, 24/7 operation, 80% cost savings. Vans are ready; roads are not.

quiz.question: What advantage do cargo-only autonomous vans have over self-driving cars?
options: No passengers means simpler safety requirements and they can operate 24/7 without breaks
